title: Heart Pieces
intro: Every four Pieces of Heart add one Heart Container. There are 36, enough for nine extra hearts; the other Heart Containers come from bosses. Grouped by region.
source_note: Written for this app. Locations follow the remake, which moved several Heart Pieces compared with the original game.

entries.title: Lon Lon Ranch - Crate storeroom
entries.steps: Enter the ruined tower in the far south-west corner of the ranch. In the storeroom full of milk crates, pull the front crates out to clear the middle column, then drag the middle crate away from the back wall. Crawl through the gap it reveals to reach the Piece of Heart.

entries.title: Kakariko Village - Man on the roof
entries.steps: Carry a Cucco over the fence by the Windmill and up the ladder to the hill behind it. Glide from there onto the blue roof of the Potion Shop, cross to the side nearest the watchtower, and drop to the lower roof where a man is lounging. Talk to him.

entries.title: Kakariko Village - Roof of the cow pen
entries.steps: From the summit of Death Mountain Trail, take the owl's ride down; he drops you on top of Impa's House. Walk to the back of the roof and step down onto the roof of the walled-in cow pen behind it. As an adult you can instead Hookshot the green vines to the left of Impa's House to get over the fence.

entries.title: Kakariko Village - Windmill ledge
entries.steps: Finish Dampe's first race to get the Hookshot. From the race's end, Hookshot to the far ledge and follow the passage that comes out high inside the Windmill. Hop across the turning parts to the ledge holding the Piece of Heart.

entries.title: House of Skulltula - 50 tokens
entries.steps: Bring 50 Gold Skulltula Tokens to the House of Skulltula and talk to the father for the reward.

entries.title: Graveyard - Dampe's digging tour
entries.steps: At night, ask Dampe for his grave-digging tour. Dirt mounds appear around the graveyard; lead him to one and pay 10 Rupees per dig. When he says he has found something heavy, pay the extra 5 Rupees he asks for: that dig is the Piece of Heart.

entries.title: Graveyard - Hidden grave chest
entries.steps: In the row of graves below the Royal Family's Tomb, pull back the grave at the southern end and drop in. There are no enemies; just open the big chest.

entries.title: Graveyard - Ruins ledge (bean ride)
requires: Magic Bean planted as a child
entries.steps: As a child, plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil beside the dead tree on the north side of the graveyard. As an adult, ride the flower platform up to the raised ruins where the Piece of Heart sits.

entries.title: Graveyard - Dampe's race under a minute
entries.steps: After winning the Hookshot, race Dampe's ghost again and finish in under 60 seconds. Keep sprinting, learn the route, and dodge his flames. The Longshot lets you skip part of the last staircase.

entries.title: Castle Town - Richard the dog
entries.steps: After the Death Mountain gate is open, the woman in the back alley reports her white dog Richard missing. In the evening, search the alley past the Bombchu Shop; Richard is round the back corner near the Treasure Chest Shop. Get him to follow you and walk him home. Other white dogs are decoys.

entries.title: Castle Town - Bombchu Bowling expert course
entries.steps: The Bombchu Bowling Alley opens after Dodongo's Cavern. Each game costs 10 Rupees and gives you 10 Bombchus to hit 3 goals. Clear the beginner and advanced courses to unlock the expert course; beating it wins the Piece of Heart. Bank Bombchus off the walls to get around obstacles.

entries.title: Castle Town - Treasure Chest game
entries.steps: Play the Treasure Chest Shop game with the Lens of Truth active so you can see which chest in each room holds the key. The last room's prize is the Piece of Heart.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Password Scrub grotto
entries.area: Hyrule Field (east of the town gate)
entries.steps: Bomb the cracked stone along the moat just east of the Castle Town gate to find a grotto with a Business Scrub who wants a password. As an adult, read the fairy writing on a tree beside the same grotto to learn it. After clearing the Forest Temple, go back as a child, give the password and buy the Piece of Heart for 100 Rupees.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Locked chest under the outcrop
entries.steps: Near the road into Gerudo Valley, a small chest sits under a big rock outcrop but will not open for a child. As an adult, read the fairy writing beside it. Once the Forest Temple is cleared, return as a child and the chest opens.

entries.title: Lost Woods - Skull Kid duet
entries.steps: From the Lost Woods entrance, go left into the small grove where a Skull Kid plays his flute. Stand on the small stump and play Saria's Song with him.

entries.title: Lost Woods - Follow-the-tune game
entries.steps: From the entrance, follow the music to the right into the area with two Skull Kids on stumps. Play their repeat-the-notes game three times: the first two rounds pay Rupees, the third and hardest pays the Piece of Heart.

entries.title: Goron City - Spinning pot
entries.steps: Light the torches around the big Goron-faced pot on the bottom floor with a Deku Stick to start it spinning. From the plank near its rim, toss a Bomb in; if the pot stops on the happy face, you get the Piece of Heart.

entries.title: Death Mountain Crater - Wall alcove
entries.steps: Just inside the crater entrance, run down the slope and right between two big rocks to the climbing mesh. Climb down to the alcove under it. The heat starts hurting you after a few seconds, so be quick.

entries.title: Death Mountain Crater - Business Scrub
entries.steps: Run down the slope from the entrance to the low platform by the broken bridge blocked by a grey rock. A Business Scrub there sells a Piece of Heart for 100 Rupees.

entries.title: Death Mountain Trail - Bean ride above Dodongo's Cavern
requires: Magic Bean planted as a child
entries.steps: As a child, plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil by the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern. As an adult, ride the flower platform up to the high ledge with the Piece of Heart.

entries.title: Death Mountain Crater - Rock pillar (bean ride)
entries.steps: Once you have the Bolero of Fire, travel back to the child era and warp to the crater with it. Plant a Magic Bean in the soil there quickly before the heat gets you, then leave. As an adult, ride the flower platform to the top of the rock pillar.

entries.title: Zora's River - Ledge above the frogs
entries.steps: Carry the Cucco from near the river's start up onto the island in the middle of the river, then use it to glide to the island's high platform and climb up. Bomb into the grotto on the island's southern high ledge to find a second Cucco, carry it to the narrow platform with the Sheikah Stone, and glide over to the ledge above the frogs.

entries.title: Zora's River - Platform by the waterfall
entries.steps: Bring the Cucco from beyond the gate past the Bean Seller up to the Zora's Domain entrance. Cross the platforms to the high ledge on the far side and glide to the tiny platform to the north-west.

entries.title: Zora's River - Song of Storms for the frogs
entries.steps: Play the Song of Storms for the frogs as a child.

entries.title: Zora's River - Frog song game
entries.steps: Play all six of these songs for the frogs, then talk to them again to start their game: play the note matching the frog the fly is hovering over, quickly, all the way through the sequence.

entries.title: Zora's Domain - Torch chest
entries.steps: Light a Deku Stick at the lit torches by King Zora's chamber and run down through the Domain lighting each unlit torch, putting the stick away and relighting it as you go. The last two are on the path behind the big waterfall. Light them all to make a chest appear.

entries.title: Zora's Fountain - Iceberg
entries.steps: Hop across the icebergs in the frozen fountain to the north-east corner.

entries.title: Zora's Fountain - Lake floor
entries.steps: Sink to the bottom of the fountain with the Iron Boots. The Piece of Heart sits in a ring of green Rupees. Wear the Zora Tunic so you do not run out of air.

entries.title: Lake Hylia - Fishing Pond
entries.steps: Rent a rod at the Fishing Pond across from the scarecrows and land a fish over 40 cm as a child.

entries.title: Lake Hylia - Observatory roof (bean ride)
requires: Magic Bean planted as a child
entries.steps: As a child, plant a Magic Bean in the soil outside the Observatory. As an adult, ride the flower platform to the top and climb the ladder to the Piece of Heart.

entries.title: Lake Hylia - Observatory diving pool
entries.steps: The scientist challenges you to touch the bottom of his 9-metre pool. Win the Golden Scale at the Fishing Pond as an adult first, then dive to the bottom and talk to him.

entries.title: Gerudo Valley - Chest across the canyon
entries.steps: Grab the Cucco near the closed bridge and glide across the canyon to the chest on the opposite wall.

entries.title: Gerudo Valley - Behind the waterfall
entries.steps: Take the Cucco from near the bridge and glide down to the large alcove at the river's edge. Follow it north to the big waterfall and climb the path behind it.

entries.title: Gerudo's Fortress - Rooftop chest
entries.steps: From the northern rooftops, climb the crumbling slope to the south-eastern roofs and double back north. At the gap you cannot cross, play the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre and Longshot to him. The chest is just to the left. Joining the Gerudo first makes this much easier.

entries.title: Gerudo's Fortress - Horseback archery
entries.steps: Ride Epona on the archery course in the south-east of the fortress. Shoot the pots and big targets and score over 750 points.

entries.title: Desert Colossus - Stone arch (bean ride)
entries.steps: After Sheik teaches you the Requiem of Spirit, warp to the Colossus as a child and plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil. As an adult, ride the flower platform over the stone arch that holds the Piece of Heart.
